title: Compute brief — 22 September 2026
description: New Era (NUAI) locks a 20-year 200–207 MW Luminant/Vistra PPA for Odessa TCDC Phase 1; Kodiak contracts 76 MW BTM gas to a hyperscaler-backed West Texas campus. Silicon Tape confirm day — Lambda H100 $3.99 / B200 $6.69; 69 confirms, 0 ticks.
og_kicker: NUAI 207 MW Vistra PPA; Kodiak 76 MW BTM; tape flat
lede: Permian power conversion moved on Monday. New Era Energy & Digital's TCDC PowerCo signed a 20-year PPA (event 18 Sep; 8-K 21 Sep) with Vistra affiliate Luminant for a minimum 200 MW and up to 207 MW for Phase 1 of the Texas Critical Data Center beside Vistra's 1,180 MW Odessa gas plant — contracted power expected Q3 2027, with $116M LC due within 15 business days of signing plus up to $82.8M more by Delivery Date. Same day, Kodiak Gas Services announced a six-year, 76 MW behind-the-meter baseload deal (~40 recip units + BOP) to a West Texas data center whose operator is contracted with an IG-rated hyperscaler and has a GPU designer as lease guarantor; deploy Q4 2026 into Q1 2027. CleanSpark's $2.276B notes remain priced with close still targeted 25 Sep. PUCT 58481 is unchanged at Interchange items 218/219 (Order Adopting §25.194; TR ack; effective 10.08.2026). The Silicon Tape is another clean confirm morning: Lambda H100 $3.99 and B200 $6.69 unchanged across 69 re-read list prints.
